prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular game-sprite identity source board for Realm's deterministic offline 2D skeletal compiler
Primary request: Create a NEW, distinctive lumberjack/woodsman identity component board while matching the exact component-board structure, painted resolution, polish, and anatomy conventions of Images 1 and 2. This is a source-parts board, not a character sheet and not an animation.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact layout and craftsperson anatomy/style reference. Image 2 is a second established Realm identity rendering reference. Preserve their classic strategy-game rendering language but do not copy either person's face, hair, beard, or body identity.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for local removal.
Subject identity: one rugged middle-aged woodsman with a broad square face, strong nose, close-cropped dark auburn hair with subtle gray at the temples, a thick short boxed beard, weathered warm-tan skin, and a sturdy broad-shouldered working build. His identity must be unmistakably the same in every view. Base layer clothing is a plain fitted charcoal undershirt and dark neutral trousers/boots so later garment layers can cover it cleanly.
Style/medium: crisp hand-painted classic 1990s strategy-game sprite source art, controlled pixel-cluster-friendly edges, warm material highlights, dark readable outline clusters, no photorealism, no blur, no dither, no soft ambient shadow.
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape. Match Image 1's modular board layout exactly: top row has three isolated heads in front, back, and left-profile views; middle row has an isolated left arm, front torso, back torso, left-profile torso, and isolated right arm; bottom row has separated leg/boot components providing front, back, and side views. All components upright, fully uncropped, separated by generous uniform gaps, and sized like Image 1. No assembled full character anywhere.
Lighting/mood: fixed upper-left warm key light identical across every component and view.
Color palette: warm-tan skin, dark auburn and restrained gray hair, charcoal cloth, dark brown boots; do not use magenta or bright pink anywhere in the subject.
Constraints: exact same person, proportions, skin tone, hairline, beard shape, undershirt, and body build across front/back/profile parts; anatomically compatible joint endpoints; hands fully visible; clean neck, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle cut zones; each component isolated; one consistent scale; background one uniform #ff00ff with no shadows, gradients, texture, floor, lighting variation, border, labels, or guides; no text; no watermark.
Avoid: assembled character, multiple people, duplicated extra heads, fantasy armor, helmet, hat, weapons, tools, props, scenery, perspective views, isometric camera, changing identity, smooth concept-art haze, green/magenta fringe, cast shadow, contact shadow.
